notes: Added missing stories to meet minimum and complete coverage across schema, core logic, API, and integration.

stories.title: Brain Lock Schema and TTL Index Definition
stories.description: Define MongoDB schema for Brain lock documents including lock_id, owner_id, acquired_at, expires_at (TTL), and status. Create TTL index on expires_at and enforce uniqueness constraints on active locks.

stories.title: Lock Acquisition and Renewal Core Logic
stories.description: Implement core lock acquisition, renewal (heartbeat), and release logic with strict ownership enforcement. Ensure only the owning process can renew or release a lock, and renewal updates TTL safely without race conditions.

stories.title: Lock Management API Endpoints
stories.description: Expose internal API endpoints for lock acquisition, renewal, release, and status check. Ensure endpoints are restricted to system/internal use with proper authentication via brain_auth and include structured responses for orchestration.
